Now do Story B on it own .

Here is the standalone B story outline for Hayley and Jeff, organized by beats with clear
headers, labeled Notes and Dialogue, and paragraph structure. It removes the main plot and
keeps only the B storyline flow.
B Story: Hayley and Jeff

Beat B1� Jeffʼs Return and Lost Chemistry

Notes:

    Jeff returns after time away and attempts to reconnect with Hayley, who is now in her
    empowered fox form.

    They kiss, but the moment falls flat; Hayley nearly gags and realizes the transformation has
    changed what she wants.

    The emotional beat reframes their relationship as something that may not survive Hayleyʼs
    evolution.
Dialogue samples:

    Francine: "How do we know?"

    Jeff: "That was… not what I remembered. Is it just me, or did something change?"
    Hayley: "Itʼs the magic side effects. Maybe weʼve changed more than we thought."

Beat B2� Hollygramʼs Test and Power Shift

Notes:

    To test Hayleyʼs attraction, Hollygram steps in and kisses Hayley, which clearly turns Hayley
    on.
    This proves Hayleyʼs desires have shifted; a new power dynamic forms between Hayley and
    Hollygram.
Dialogue samples:

    Hollygram: "I still got it." (smacks Hayleyʼs ass) "Cardio, 8pm, come."
    Hayley: "Yes, mommy—wait, no, I am the mommy now. I have to assert my dominance… but
    she… good, damn good. Itʼs going to be a power struggle."
    Jeff: "Woah, that was pretty hot, but I guess… this is goodbye…"

Beat B3� Jeffʼs Idea to Transition

Notes:

    After witnessing the changes and thinking during a long, smoky walk, Jeff has an epiphany
    about saving their relationship.
    He proposes becoming a woman, inspired by the visible proof that transformation is
    possible.
Dialogue samples:

    Jeff: "If Hayley can transform Stella into that… What if, babe, you make a woman out of
    me?"

    Hayley: "Youʼre serious?"
    Jeff: "Yeah. If it saves my marriage."

Beat B4� The Ask and Calling in Backup

Notes:

    Jeff confirms he wants this; Hayley is cautious and calls for support given theyʼve never
    permanently transformed a human.
    A quick transitional beat shows the household chaos: Stella/Steve is distracted by the
    imposed persona, which nudges Hayley to seek outside help.
Dialogue samples:

    Hayley: "Are you sure?"
    Jeff: "I am."

    Hayley: "Hey, nerd, get off the couch, stop groping your boobs, and help me out here."
    Big Tiddy Female Steve: "Maybe we should call Mom, too. I mean, weʼre shapeshifting foxes
    —weʼve never permanently transformed a human before."
    Hayley: "Yeah… good point." (places the call)

Beat B5� CIA Ballistic Test and The Nanomachine Plan

Notes:

    At the CIA, Agent Bullock runs “ballistic tests” on Rainee in her Agent Double D form; itʼs
    absurd but demonstrates protective capabilities.
    Amid the chaos, Rainee outlines a nanomachine-based method: infuse life energy and, with
    Stellaʼs assistance, install a self-sustaining transformation system in Jeff.
    Warnings are clear: once inside, nanomachines are hard to remove.

Dialogue samples:

    Stan: "Is this really a good use of CIA time? We should be working to combat terrorists!"

    Bullock: "Stop being a stick in the mud and go mop the bathroom!"

Hayley: "Whatʼs that noise?"
    Rainee: "Oh, the CIA is doing ‘ballistic tests.ʼ"

    Bullock: "YES! 100 points! Kobe Bryant in the house!"
    Rainee: "Our forms work using nanomachines—think Star Trek. If you infuse a fragment of
    your life energy into it with Stellaʼs help, we can replicate and reforge Jeff into a beautiful girl
    that sustains itself without external guidance. But be careful—itʼs very hard to get
    nanomachines out once theyʼre inside. Theyʼre little terminators, ya know."
    Jeff: "Hey, Mrs. R, I am ready for womanhood. Iʼve thought about it—if it saves my
    marriage."

    Rainee: "Letʼs give it a shot." (bonks Bullock with a frying pan) "I need to get back to CIA
    ‘work.ʼ Love ya!"

    Duper: "Heads up!" (basketballs ricochet off Rainee, slam Stan)
    Bullock: "Nice shot, Duper! Extra points for hitting killjoy Stan!"

Beat B6� Jess Emerges and New Normal

Notes:

    The plan goes forward; Jeff transitions and embraces the new identity, Jess, aligning with
    Hayleyʼs evolved desires.
    Jess acclimates quickly and chooses to join Hayleyʼs world, symbolized by leaning into the
    “ass cult” gag as a confident, playful capper to their arc.
Dialogue samples:

    Jess: "Call me Jess. Feels right already."
    Hayley: "Welcome home."

    Jess: "Letʼs make this work—on our terms."
